mentions.name: Hacker News Comments browser extension
mentions.description: A browser extension that makes reading comment pages (like Hacker News) easier: it clearly marks new threads and threads with new child comments since the page was last opened, and makes collapsing and uncollapsing threads easier and prettier.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A simple browser extension that makes reading comments pages like this one much easier: clearly marks new threads (and threads with new child comments) since last opened, and makes collapsing / uncollapsing threads easier and prettier:
https://github.com/bachmitre/hacker-news-comments
mentions.author: bachmitre
